## Checklist

- [ ] `buildtool check test` passes (Code Analyzer clean, every test green)
- [ ] A regression test fails without this change (for fixes)
- [ ] Public classes and methods have help text
- [ ] No new dependency (the toolbox has none; anything new is justified in CONTRIBUTING.md and approved)
- [ ] The toolbox still computes no statistics (no summing or interpolating quantiles)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
